entities.summary: Kandyan Kingdom, a political institution in Sri Lanka during Portuguese Colonial Period (1505–1658). Grew from Portuguese arrive in Ceylon and gradually conquer the coastal kingdoms. Led to the emergence of Portuguese Conquest and Kandyan Resistance.
